surface_summary: The La Chance mine is plagued by mysterious deaths, sabotage, and theft. Suspicion falls on various characters including Paulette Brown and the new superintendent Macartney, with wolf bait and secret meetings adding to the intrigue.
accepted_facts: Thompson, the former superintendent, was found dead under suspicious circumstances.
Macartney is the new mine superintendent and has a secretive and suspicious nature.
Wolf bait was used to lure wolves to attack Dudley Wilbraham.
Paulette Brown is actually Tatiana Paulina Valenka, linked to a stolen emerald necklace.
inferred_conclusions: Paulette Brown is a thief and involved in the murders.
Dunn and Collins are dead and not involved in the conspiracy.
mechanism_description: Macartney, whose real name is Dick Hutton, orchestrated a plan to take over the La Chance mine by murdering Thompson and Dudley Wilbraham. He used wolf bait to cause Dudley's death and sabotaged the mine's operations. He sealed the gold boxes to prevent theft but planned to steal them himself. Dunn and Collins, initially thought dead, were his accomplices hiding in secret tunnels. The truth was revealed through Thompson's secret messages and the efforts of Nick Stretton and Paulette.
delivery_path: Macartney uses wolf bait to lure wolves to attack Dudley Wilbraham.
He sabotages the road by placing a boulder to cripple the wagon carrying gold.
Macartney murders four mill men during a staged robbery at the assay office.
He kills Thompson after capturing him and forces him to write a false letter.
Dunn and Collins hide in secret tunnels to assist Macartney.
Nick Stretton discovers the secret tunnels and Thompson's messages.
Macartney is confronted and killed after his plot is exposed.
outcome_result: Macartney (Dick Hutton) is exposed as the murderer and criminal mastermind, and order is restored with the mine and Paulette safe.

false_assumption.statement: Paulette Brown is guilty of theft and involved in the murders.
false_assumption.why_it_seems_reasonable: Paulette's secret identity as Tatiana Paulina Valenka and her mysterious behavior suggest guilt. The sealed gold boxes and her secret meetings with a man in the dark add suspicion.
false_assumption.what_it_hides: It hides the fact that Macartney is the true culprit manipulating events and that Paulette is a victim trying to protect herself and Dudley.

supporting_points: Billy Jones was found near Thompson's body and had a suspicious demeanor.
Dudley Wilbraham accused him of possible murder.
Billy Jones was fired suddenly and mysteriously.
He had no alibi for the time of Thompson's death.
false_solution.the_one_flaw: Billy Jones was incapable of the complex conspiracy and had no motive to kill Thompson or Dudley.

red_herrings.description: Paulette Brown's real identity as Tatiana Paulina Valenka and her connection to a stolen emerald necklace.
red_herrings.innocent_explanation: She was protecting herself from Macartney's threats and was not involved in theft or murder.

red_herrings.description: Dunn and Collins were believed dead and suspected of conspiracy.
red_herrings.innocent_explanation: They were alive and hiding in secret tunnels, working against Macartney.

closed_circle.rationale: All key characters are present at La Chance or Skunk's Misery with limited access to the mine and surrounding bush, forming a closed circle of suspects and witnesses.

time_anchors: Thompson's letter dated before his death
Collins and Dunn's disappearance and reappearance
time_windows: Night of the staged robbery at assay office
Night of Dudley's death in the bush
trust_channels: Charliet's role as cook and ally
authority_sources: Local posse and informal leadership by Nick Stretton

inference_path.observation: Thompson's letter had a hidden message inside the envelope.
inference_path.correction: The message was a warning about Macartney's true identity and danger.
inference_path.effect: Revealed Macartney as the murderer and criminal mastermind.
required_evidence: Thompson's letter with hidden pencil scrawl inside envelope
Thompson's playing cards with secret writing

inference_path.observation: Wolf bait was found in the wagon and on the road.
inference_path.correction: Macartney used wolf bait to lure wolves to attack Dudley.
inference_path.effect: Showed Macartney's involvement in Dudley's death.
required_evidence: Broken bottle of wolf bait in wagon
Dead wolf with throat cut near corduroy road

inference_path.observation: Four mill men were found dead in the assay office.
inference_path.correction: Macartney staged a robbery and killed them to eliminate witnesses.
inference_path.effect: Confirmed Macartney's violent methods to secure control.
required_evidence: Dead mill men with gunshot wounds in assay office
Macartney's empty revolver and slashed doorpost

inference_path.observation: Dunn and Collins were believed dead but reappeared alive.
inference_path.correction: They were hiding in secret tunnels and allied with Macartney.
inference_path.effect: Revealed complicity of Dunn and Collins in the conspiracy.
required_evidence: Dunn and Collins' presence in Skunk's Misery den

inference_path.observation: Paulette Brown's real name and connection to emerald theft.
inference_path.correction: She was innocent and a victim of Macartney's schemes.
inference_path.effect: Cleared Paulette of theft and implicated Macartney.
required_evidence: Van Ruyne's emerald necklace found on Macartney

inference_path.observation: Macartney was seen with Marcia Wilbraham and had fainting fits.
inference_path.correction: Macartney is Dick Hutton, the criminal mastermind.
inference_path.effect: Identified Macartney as the true culprit behind murders and theft.
required_evidence: Thompson's deuce of hearts with message

inference_path.observation: Macartney's men were ambushed and killed by explosion in Thompson's stope.
inference_path.correction: Nick Stretton and allies used explosives to trap Macartney's gang.
inference_path.effect: Led to Macartney's downfall and capture.
required_evidence: High explosive placed in Thompson's stope
Explosion and collapse of tunnel entrance

discriminating_test.design: Nick Stretton and his allies set a trap by sealing themselves in Thompson's stope and placing high explosives at the tunnel entrance. They lure Macartney and his gang into the stope and detonate the explosives to incapacitate them. This forces Macartney into a direct confrontation, revealing his identity and guilt.
discriminating_test.knowledge_revealed: The trap exposes Macartney as the murderer and criminal mastermind behind the murders, theft, and sabotage at La Chance mine.
discriminating_test.pass_condition: Macartney and his gang are incapacitated by the explosion and forced into a confrontation where Macartney's identity and crimes are revealed.

fair_play_explanation: The reader is given access to all key clues including Thompson's hidden messages, the wolf bait evidence, the sealed gold boxes, and the suspicious behavior of Macartney. The secret tunnels and the identity of Macartney as Dick Hutton are hinted at through multiple observations. The false solution accusing Billy Jones is presented and refuted. The final trap and confession are logically deduced from the gathered evidence.

anchors.claim: Nick Stretton returns to La Chance mine and meets Paulette Brown
anchors.anchor: I opened the shack door and went in,--and in the bare passage I jerked up taut

anchors.claim: Paulette Brown seals the gold boxes to prevent substitution
anchors.anchor: On each box, just as I had expected even before I heard Paulette Brown say she had marked them, was a tiny seal in blue wax

anchors.claim: Wolf bait is used to lure wolves to attack Dudley Wilbraham
anchors.anchor: That same wolf bait had been put in my wagon by somebody,--and the human cry out of the swamp at Paulette's shot suddenly repeated itself in my ears

anchors.claim: Thompson's letter contains a hidden warning inside the envelope
anchors.anchor: Take care, Macartney! Gold, life, everything--in danger!

anchors.claim: Macartney is revealed as Dick Hutton, the criminal mastermind
anchors.anchor: For the written message on Thompson's lost card was plain. Macartney was--Hutton!

anchors.claim: Four mill men are murdered in the assay office during a staged robbery
anchors.anchor: They were decent men too, for they were the last of our own lot,--and it smote me like a hammer that they might have been alive still if I had not interfered with Paulette that night and kept her from meeting Hutton

anchors.claim: Dunn and Collins are alive and hiding in secret tunnels
anchors.anchor: I saw Dunn and Collins! Saw Dunn's stubbly fair hair, clipped close till it stood on end

anchors.claim: Macartney uses wolf dope and sabotage to control the mine
anchors.anchor: I knew about Macartney's wolf dope business long ago, and do you suppose _this_

anchors.claim: Paulette Brown is actually Tatiana Paulina Valenka
anchors.anchor: The signature she wrote as plainly as I write it now was not Paulette Brown. It was Tatiana Paulina

anchors.claim: Macartney kills Dudley Wilbraham using wolf bait and ambush
anchors.anchor: They got Mr. Wilbraham, and--they damn nearly got me!

anchors.claim: Nick Stretton and allies use explosives to trap Macartney's gang
anchors.anchor: I heard the fuse burn smooth as a dream, and Collins nudged me with fierce satisfaction

anchors.claim: Macartney is killed after his crimes are exposed
anchors.anchor: Macartney only stood there, looking so much as usual that I guessed he must have rested outside the mouth of our burrow before he wormed down to tackle me

anchors.claim: Billy Jones is falsely accused of murder
anchors.anchor: Not a day went by that three or four of them did not come for their time

anchors.claim: Marcia Wilbraham betrays Paulette and helps Macartney
anchors.anchor: Marcia flung herself on him as if she had only just realized him

anchors.claim: Nick Stretton and Paulette escape across Lac Tremblant on snowshoes
anchors.anchor: I led my dream girl out on it. I would have given half my life for a rope

anchors.claim: Thompson's boy provides key testimony about the murder
anchors.anchor: You? What's the matter with you? Brace up; it's only me!

anchors.claim: Macartney's gang is defeated and the mine is saved
anchors.anchor: An abandoned picket has a way of knowing when the game is up, and Macartney's men had cleared out on the double

anchors.claim: Paulette and Nick Stretton confess their love
anchors.anchor: I knew the dark hollows and the tear marks under her eyes were for Dudley, not for me

anchors.claim: Thompson's playing cards contain a secret message
anchors.anchor: For God's sake search my cards--my cards--my cards
